entities.name: Orn
entities.description: Walled sanctuary in Indatha on Ikoria, destroyed long ago.

entities.name: Indatha
entities.description: Region of Ikoria where Orn stood.

entities.name: Skysail
entities.description: Sky settlement of joined hot-air balloons formed by Orn's survivors.

entities.name: Skysail sky dwellers
entities.description: People of Skysail, descended from Orn's survivors.

events.summary: One night the luminous creatures that lit Orn did not come, and nightmares breached the gates.
events.quote: But one night, for unknown reasons, the luminous creatures did not come, and nightmares breached the gates under cover of darkness.

events.summary: Survivors of Orn built hot-air balloons and joined their vessels together, forming Skysail.
events.quote: More and more balloonists joined their vessels together, forming what's now known as Skysail.
